question: Fill in the blank (3) with the appropriate word from the options below:
solution:
The correct answer is **Option 4.**

 

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__**

__
 
• The adjective "**innovative**" means introducing new ideas; original and creative in thinking. (नवीन)
 
• In this context, **"encourages innovative thinking and creativity" **highlights how education promotes original and creative ways of thinking.
 
• The other options: "**orthodox**", "**conventional**", and "**uniform**" do not fit the context as appropriately.

​Therefore, the correct answer is '**Option 4**'.

**Complete Sentence:** Education is a powerful tool for development and personal growth. It equips individuals with knowledge and skills, enabling them to seize opportunities and contribute to society. A well-rounded education not only fosters academic excellence but also encourages innovative__ thinking and creativity. Moreover, education instils virtuous values and ethical principles in individuals, promoting social harmony and responsible citizenship. To ensure the benefits of education are accessible to all, it is essential to eliminate barriers, such as isolation and discrimination, that hinder equal access to quality learning opportunities.

 

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **__Additional Information__**

 
• **Orthodox (रूढ़िवादी)**: means conforming to established beliefs or doctrines, especially in religion.
 
• **Conventional (परंपरागत)**: means based on or in accordance with what is generally done or believed.
 
• **Uniform (एकसमान)**: means remaining the same in all cases and at all times; unchanging in form or character.
